title: Contract Pricing Agreement Rebate Clawback Size Bands by Return Credit
content:
**Size of the return credit and the Contract Pricing Agreement rebate clawback — training questions answered**

*What decides the size share?* The return credit determined on the return receipt, as recorded on the customer's Ship-To Fulfillment Account records. On a Contract Pricing Agreement, the size share multiplies the unrounded rebate clawback for that return before the clawback's limit, its floor at 0.00 and its rounding to the cent are applied.

*What are the bands?*

| Return credit on the receipt | Size share |
|---|---|
| Below 500.00 | 0 |
| At least 500.00 and below 5000.00 | 0.5 |
| 5000.00 or more | 1 |

*Where do the edges fall?* A return credit of 499.99 carries 0; exactly 500.00 carries 0.5; 4999.99 carries 0.5; exactly 5000.00 carries 1.

*Worked case (hypothetical).* A return credit of 1200.00 whose unrounded clawback is 12.00 carries 0.5, giving 6.00.
